about.title: About Speed Duel: Streets of Battle City
paragraphs: Speed Duel: Streets of Battle City is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG pack released on 24 August 2023, in the SEVENS & GO RUSH!! era. It has 191 cards, and with the 20 other rarities there are 211 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 191 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 211, adding the 20 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
